description: Static keyword database for ATS CV optimization focused on DevOps and Cloud Engineering

devops.description: Comprehensive DevOps keywords including CI/CD, containerization, IaC, monitoring, and automation tools

cloud.description: Cloud engineering keywords covering AWS, Azure, GCP services, and cloud-native technologies

usage.description: These keyword files are used by the CV analysis system to identify technical skills and provide ATS optimization recommendations
usage.integration: Keywords are loaded and compared against CV content to generate 'found' and 'missing' keyword lists
